crossRefs.note: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is…

translations.web: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
translations.bsb: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”
translations.kjv: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
translations.asv: that the word might be fulfilled which he spake, Of those whom thou hast given me I lost not one.
